mentions.name: Yard Sale Manager iOS App
mentions.description: This iOS app helps people manage yard sales by cataloguing unused household items and selling them in person. A planned v2 adds a Facebook Marketplace-style feature where users can discover yard sales near them and potentially browse the items being sold at a specific sale before showing up.
mentions.problem: There's a lot of clutter at home that people don't need or use.
mentions.source_excerpt: An iOS app to help manage Yard Sales. There's a lot of clutter at home that we don't need or use; using that as inspiration to work on an app that can help with cataloguing and selling in-person, and in v2 turn into some sort of facebook marketplace where users can 'find yard sales' near them (and potentially even look up all items being sold at x yard sale, prior to showing up).
